Title: Marketing Science Analyst BI Conversational Analytics Data Engineering
Title reason: SCOPE_AMBIGUITY

# Role Overview
We are seeking a Marketing Science Senior Analyst to help design, build, and scale modern marketing analytics solutions that connect marketing investments to business outcomes.
This role sits at the intersection of data engineering, analytics, measurement, and business intelligence, with a strong focus on developing robust data foundations, scalable reporting ecosystems, and AI-enabled analytics capabilities.
You're equally comfortable building data pipelines, designing reporting frameworks, developing dashboards, and translating business questions into actionable insights.
You will partner closely with Marketing Science, Media, Analytics, CRM, and Engineering teams to create scalable solutions that support enterprise B2B marketing measurement and decision-making.
# Key Responsibilities
# Data Engineering & Data Foundations
- Design, build, and maintain scalable data pipelines integrating marketing, CRM, web analytics, partner, and business outcome data.
- Develop unified data models that support cross-channel measurement and reporting.
- Establish data governance, documentation, taxonomy standards, and metadata management processes.
- Implement data quality controls, automated validation checks, and anomaly detection mechanisms.
- Support the development of scalable reporting datasets and semantic layers consumed by dashboarding and analytics tools.
- Collaborate with technical teams to optimize data architecture, performance, and reliability.
# Analytics, Reporting & Dashboard Development
- Design and develop dashboards and reporting solutions for executive, operational, and campaign-level stakeholders.
- Translate business objectives into KPIs, reporting frameworks, and measurement solutions.
- Build scalable datasets, calculated metrics, and reusable reporting structures.
- Support self-service analytics initiatives by creating intuitive reporting experiences.
- Deliver regular performance reporting, campaign analysis, and insight generation.
- Support Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs), campaign recaps, and stakeholder presentations.
# Measurement & Marketing Analytics
- Develop and maintain measurement frameworks aligned to marketing and business objectives.
- Define KPIs across demand creation, engagement, progression, conversion, and pipeline contribution.
- Establish performance baselines and benchmarking methodologies.
- Conduct analytical deep dives to identify opportunities for optimization and growth.
- Support advanced analytics initiatives including attribution, forecasting, trend analysis, audience segmentation, and marketing effectiveness studies.
- Partner with stakeholders to ensure measurement approaches evolve alongside business priorities.
# AI & Conversational Analytics
- Support the adoption of AI-enabled analytics and reporting capabilities.
- Develop automated insight generation and performance monitoring processes.
- Implement anomaly detection and alerting frameworks to proactively identify issues and opportunities.
- Enable conversational analytics experiences that allow stakeholders to interact with data through natural language.
- Evaluate emerging technologies that improve reporting efficiency and decision-making.
# Collaboration & Leadership
- Partner with Marketing Science, Media, CRM, Analytics, and Engineering teams to align business requirements and technical solutions.
- Present findings, insights, and recommendations to stakeholders in a clear and actionable manner.
- Contribute to analytics best practices, governance standards, and documentation.
# Experience
- Bachelor's degree in Business Analytics, Computer Science, Engineering, Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, or a related quantitative field.
- 3-5 years of experience in Marketing Analytics, Business Intelligence, Data Analytics, Data Engineering, or Marketing Science.
- Strong SQL skills and experience working with large and complex datasets.
- Experience building and maintaining data pipelines, ETL/ELT processes, and data integration workflows.
- Hands-on experience developing dashboards and business intelligence solutions.
- Experience translating business needs into reporting requirements and analytical solutions.
- Familiarity with cloud-based data platforms and modern data architectures.
- Strong analytical, problem-solving, and stakeholder communication skills.

- Vacation, compassionate leave, sick days, and flex days
- Access to online services for families and new parents
- Diversity and Inclusion Board with 12 affinity groups
- Internal learning and development programs
- Enterprise-wide employee discounts
- And more…

# Position Overview
We are looking for a Sr. Business Systems Analyst to join our growing and transforming team.
This is a challenging position that requires a strong background in Oracle Fusion SCM Applications and supporting business processes.
The ideal candidate is a strong hands-on subject matter expert that is comfortable working in a fast-paced environment.
The job requires excellent organizational skills and attention to detail so that requests are handled in a uniform manner, issues are properly documented, and projects are delivered on time.
The successful candidate is very motivated and willing to take on challenges, able to multi-task and can work independently with minimal oversight.
# Responsibilities
The Sr. Business Systems Analyst will serve as a liaison between business and technical teams, partnering closely with Operations, Manufacturing, Logistics, Sales, Finance, and Engineering, to gather requirements that ensure our ERP systems can scale to meet growing business needs.
The systems analyst will troubleshoot issues, analyze operational procedures, develop business process solutions, prepare process flowcharts, and make configurations.

- Help define the technology roadmap for our supply chain systems.
- Lead product/project discovery, solution definition, requirement elicitation sessions, and walkthroughs.
- Make recommendations for solutions, or improvements, to business processes that can be accomplished through new technology or alternative uses of existing technology.

- Perform gap analysis, identify process improvements, and provide recommendations to address discrepancies between business requirements and system capabilities.
- Produce timely and high-quality work product requirements including specifications, process flows, mock-ups, and wireframes.
- Develop and execute comprehensive test plans, conduct system testing, and facilitate user acceptance testing to ensure system integrity and accuracy.
- Provide technical expertise in troubleshooting and resolving complex system issues.
- Provide root cause analysis to resolve system issues.
- Maintain documentation of system configurations, processes, and procedures, ensuring compliance with organizational policies and standards.
- Become deeply immersed and knowledgeable about core business functions, processes, and workflows associated with assigned business areas and projects.
- Manage the deployment, monitoring, maintenance and support of test and production
- environments of all financial systems.
- Support quarterly patch testing, regression testing, and validation of system changes.
- Manage security configurations, including role-based access and segregation of duties for finance users.
- Assist in system updates, journal bookings and postings, data loads using ADFDI, and routine maintenance activities.
- Support month-end close activities and ensure financial system readiness
- Ensure compliance with SOX and ITGC with proper documentation.
# Qualifications
- Bachelor’s degree in accounting or information technology or relevant experience.
- 5+ years as a Business or Systems Analyst, gathering requirements and supporting finance or technology teams.
- 5+ years Oracle Financial Applications (Cloud is required.
- Deep Manufacturing, Supply Chain Planning & Cost Management module experience
- Experience working with agile delivery frameworks, specially creating user stories for non-technical end users.
- Ability to perform basic to moderate queries in SQL.
- Experience with BI Publisher, OBIEE, Oracle EPM, Hyperion, Snowflake, Sigma, is a plus.
- Experience with ERP integrations is a plus.
- Public company experience is a plus.
